ideas.title: Deep Dive into Minnesota Welfare Fraud Allegations
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota, focusing on the alleged involvement of state officials. This story would involve analyzing financial records, interviewing whistleblowers, and reviewing existing investigations.
questions: What is the total amount of alleged welfare fraud?
What actions have been taken so far?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves public trust and potential misuse of funds meant for vulnerable populations. A deep dive could uncover systemic issues and lead to significant reforms.

ideas.title: Gateway Tunnel Project: A Case Study in Funding Disputes
ideas.description: Examine the Gateway Tunnel project's funding dispute, focusing on the causes of the delay, the impact on the project's timeline and budget, and the resolution. This story would involve reviewing project documents, interviewing key stakeholders, and analyzing the financial implications.
questions: What were the main causes of the funding dispute?
How did the delay impact the project's timeline and budget?
What are the long-term implications for the project's success?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights the complexities of large infrastructure projects and the potential for disputes over funding. A detailed analysis could provide insights into managing such projects more effectively.
